note: P4258 (Pro 25:5) — take the wicked from the king's presence, and his throne is established in righteousness.

dims.v: corruption — the wicked whose removal purifies the throne
the wicked at the king's court, whose removal is required if the throne is to stand — corruption near power that must be purged
the righteousness that then establishes the throne (266126)
set against the righteousness a purged court secures

rasha — 'take away the WICKED from the presence of the king'; wicked counsellors corrupt a reign; remove them and the throne stands. Righteousness, not the wicked, secures a kingdom (cf 16:12; 20:8, 28).
just rule — that establishes the throne once the wicked are gone
the righteousness in which the king's throne is established once the wicked are removed — justice as the foundation of enduring rule
the wicked whose removal frees it (266121)
set against the corruption a purged court removes
tsedeq (righteousness) — 'his throne will be established in RIGHTEOUSNESS'; a throne stands not on power but on justice. Purge the wicked, and righteousness secures the reign.
